title: RBI Tightens Governance Norms for Urban & Rural Co-operative Banks
summary: RBI mandates a 3-year cooling-off period for directors completing 10 years of continuous tenure on the board of UCBs and RCBs.

blocks.content: RBI issued immediate governance directions requiring a **3-year cooling-off period** for directors completing 10 continuous years on UCB/RCB boards under Banking Laws (Amendment) Act 2025.

provenance.sourceTitle: RBI Tightens Governance Norms for Urban & Rural Co-operative Banks
